title: Effects of a Psycho‐Behavioural Intervention on Cancer‐Related Fatigue Among Patients With Colorectal Cancer: A Pilot Randomised Controlled Trial
comparison_or_design: The six-week psycho-behavioural pilot trial in post-treatment colorectal cancer.
observations_or_assays: PROMIS Sleep Disturbance Short Form 4a score
time_scope: Baseline T0 and within one week after the 6-week intervention (T1).
excluded: Fatigue subscales, dietary behavior, anxiety and depression
Feasibility, acceptability, qualitative interviews and attendance/recruitment metrics
population_or_material: Post-treatment colorectal cancer patients in the pilot randomized comparison, retaining the reported outcome-analysis denominators.
requested_items: For the three domains: arm-level T0/T1 means, group-by-time interaction F with its P, and Hedges g with CI. Exclude whole-cohort summaries, separate group/time main effects and duplicated P-only rows.
